A basement pasta bar beneath The Back Room at The Toy Hotel, Chandigarh. Pasta made by hand, the way it is done in Italy. Brass, leather and low light.

Food Menu

a slow shift in flavour, from light to dark

How to eat like an Italian a short guide

Italian food tastes best in company: an aperitivo to open the evening, a glass of wine beside the pasta, and no one in a hurry.

AntipastiStarters, made for the middle of the table. Order a few and begin.
Pasta BarFive styles of handmade pasta, the heart of the menu. This is where to spend your time.
RisottoCarnaroli, stirred slowly. Two ways, one dark, one green.
PizzetteSmall Italian pizzas, sized for one. They sit happily beside a pasta.
SecondiThe main course that comes after the pasta. Chicken and fish, cooked simply.
ContorniSides, for the table. Greens, potatoes, fries, pass them around.
DolciDessert, the Italian way. The meal ends when something sweet arrives.
AperitivoCocktails built in five chapters, light to dark. Ask for the flight to taste all five.

A Gentle Shift975
